# m3a

> Humanoid character animation for AI coding agents: motion clips as readable JSON, a deterministic TypeScript runtime
> that plays them on any humanoid rig, a three.js adapter, sensors that check motion as numbers without a display, a
> licensed clip library, and one tool registry served as an API, the `m3a` command and an MCP server.

Start with the manual: the whole API by job (find, fit, wire, make, check, ship, grow) in at most 8,000 tokens, with one
worked example. Pick clips from the catalogs' rows (id, length, loop or once, speed, tags, what it does, source), never
by reading motion data. Every tool is a command of `m3a`: `npx m3a` where `@m3a/tools` is installed, and in this
repository after `npm ci` (its bin is `packages/tools/src/node.ts`, which `.mcp.json` runs with `node`). Its `help` lists every tool, one line each, and its `mcp` serves them over MCP
(stdio). Only the CC0 sets ship by default; the CC BY and CMU sets are opt-in.

## Docs

- [The manual](packages/tools/MANUAL.md): the mental model, one worked example, the API by job, the rules and common mistakes
- [The skill](skills/m3a/SKILL.md): when to reach for m3a, and the five commands that matter most
- [The tool list](packages/tools/src/tools/index.ts): every tool in `m3a help`'s order, each group's tools in its own file
- [The MCP config](.mcp.json): `node packages/tools/src/node.ts mcp`, for an agent working in this repository

## Library catalogs

- [QUATERNIUS_3D2DGE](library/sets/QUATERNIUS_3D2DGE/catalog.tsv): CC0, Quaternius' Universal Animation Library
- [QUATERNIUS_SHARDFALL](library/sets/QUATERNIUS_SHARDFALL/catalog.tsv): CC0, Quaternius' Universal Animation Library
- [MESH2MOTION](library/sets/MESH2MOTION/catalog.tsv): CC0, Mesh2Motion's human animations
- [STYLE100](library/sets/STYLE100/catalog.tsv): CC BY 4.0 (opt-in), 100STYLE's walks in a hundred styles
- [STYLE100_BACK](library/sets/STYLE100_BACK/catalog.tsv): CC BY 4.0 (opt-in), 100STYLE walking backwards
- [STYLE100_BACKRUN](library/sets/STYLE100_BACKRUN/catalog.tsv): CC BY 4.0 (opt-in), 100STYLE running backwards
- [STYLE100_IDLE](library/sets/STYLE100_IDLE/catalog.tsv): CC BY 4.0 (opt-in), 100STYLE's idles
- [STYLE100_RUN](library/sets/STYLE100_RUN/catalog.tsv): CC BY 4.0 (opt-in), 100STYLE's runs
- [STYLE100_SIDE](library/sets/STYLE100_SIDE/catalog.tsv): CC BY 4.0 (opt-in), 100STYLE's sidesteps
- [STYLE100_SIDERUN](library/sets/STYLE100_SIDERUN/catalog.tsv): CC BY 4.0 (opt-in), 100STYLE's side runs
- [CMU_CURATED](library/sets/CMU_CURATED/catalog.tsv): CMU's motion capture, curated (opt-in; not for resale, even converted)

## Registry

- [The registry index](library/index.json): every set's versions (content id, digest, tier, licenses, clips, bytes, QA and review counts), immutable and yanked never deleted, plus community packs from namespaces verified to their owners; `npm run index -- verify <SET> <dir>` checks a set's files against it

## Spec

- [The motion format](spec/MOTION.md): a clip's fields, keys and versioning
- [The legend](spec/LEGEND.md): how to read a clip's numbers, with one worked key
- [The skeleton profile](spec/SKELETON.md): the humanoid bones a character binds to

## Optional

- [Recipes](spec/RECIPE.md): making a clip from clips, step by step
- [Graphs](spec/GRAPH.md): states, transitions, layers and events a game drives
- [Actions](spec/ACTION.md): one motion made of several beats
- [Simulation](spec/SIM.md): a graph run on scripted game input, and its trace
- [The library](docs/LIBRARY.md): every set's tier, license, fit and QA verdicts
